parameters.rpcParams: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_service_name: 'n8n', p_action: 'health_check_all', p_action_detail: { timestamp: $json.timestamp, totalServices: $json.totalServices, healthyCount: $json.healthyCount, degradedCount: $json.degradedCount, degradedServices: $json.degradedServices, avgResponseMs: $json.avgResponseMs }, p_status: $json.hasIssues ? 'partial' : 'success', p_duration_ms: $json.totalResponseMs }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ p_service_name: 'n8n', p_action: 'health_alert', p_action_detail: { severity: $json.severity, degradedServices: $json.degradedServices, message: $json.message }, p_status: 'failure', p_duration_ms: 0 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ p_service_name: 'n8n', p_action: 'self_healing_attempt', p_action_detail: { recoveryResults: $json.recoveryResults, recoveryCount: $json.recoveryCount }, p_status: 'success', p_duration_ms: 0 }) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'critical', subject: 'Service Recovery Failed — Human Intervention Required', message: 'Auto-recovery circuit breaker tripped. The following services could not be recovered after 3 attempts:

' + JSON.stringify($('Self-Healing Logic').item.json.escalations, null, 2) + '

Original alert:
' + $('Self-Healing Logic').item.json.originalAlert.message, context: { escalations: $('Self-Healing Logic').item.json.escalations, originalAlert: $('Self-Healing Logic').item.json.originalAlert }, source: 'health_monitor' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ action: 'admin_bridge_alert', severity: $json.severity || 'warning', alert: { degradedServices: $json.originalAlert?.degradedServices || [], recoveryActions: $json.recoveryActions || [], escalations: $json.escalations || [], timestamp: $json.timestamp }, source: 'health_monitor' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ action: 'workflow_drift_detected', severity: ($json.missingWorkflows || []).length > 2 ? 'high' : 'medium', alert: { missingWorkflows: $json.missingWorkflows || [], inactiveWorkflows: $json.inactiveWorkflows || [], totalExpected: $json.totalExpected || 0, totalFound: $json.totalFound || 0, timestamp: $json.timestamp || new Date().toISOString() }, source: 'health_monitor' }) }}
